The groomer

One person, every dog

Heather runs it herself — the same hands book you, bathe the dog, and hand it back.

She describes the business in five words on her own page: full-service dog grooming, serving Orting and the surrounding areas. There's no front desk between you and the person holding the clippers.

Back in October 2022 she was grooming out of another salon's space in Orting. Since then she's built it into her own thing, and she recently added mobile grooming alongside the stationary option — so the table can come to your driveway, or you can come to it.

Three steps and the dog's on the table

  1. Call or text

    Texting is the quickest way to reach her — say what kind of dog you have and roughly when you'd like to come in.

  2. Pick mobile or in Orting

    She'll tell you what works for your dog and whether she's coming to you or you're coming to her.

  3. Show up with the dog

    She takes it from there — bath, dry, haircut, and something around the neck on the way home.
